_about: Max Duncker (1811-1886), German historian: History of Greece from the Earliest Times to the End of the Persian War, tr. Sarah Frances Alleyne (vol. I, 1883) and Alleyne and Evelyn Abbott (vol. II, 1886); only these two volumes were Englished. His History of Antiquity is Near Eastern history, not taken. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dd). Raw IA OCR. No uids minted.
